profiles.name: Binary analysis
profiles.description: Inspects authorized local binary artifacts and reports evidence.

profiles.name: API reverse engineering
profiles.description: Analyzes authorized API traffic, schemas and local client artifacts.

profiles.name: Endpoint analysis
profiles.description: Maps authorized endpoint behavior and evidence from supplied artifacts.

profiles.name: Script reverse engineering
profiles.description: Analyzes scripts and documents behavior with reproducible evidence.

profiles.name: Vulnerability discovery
profiles.description: Finds and documents vulnerabilities in explicitly authorized targets.

profiles.name: Exploit validation
profiles.description: Validates a reported issue only in the explicitly authorized lab or target scope.
profiles.prompt: Test only targets and artifacts explicitly authorized in the task. Do not expand scope, persist access, or affect third-party systems. Report the smallest reproducible evidence and stop when the finding is validated.
